description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Amendment Exord Gaz.No. 1711/24 of June 24, 2011, which Specifies the Faculties and the Department of the University of Sri Jayawardenapura Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under statutory powers that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of a university. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the core legal/regulatory function of amending existing legislation and university governance structures, rather than focusing on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
